props.title: Quadrasonic joins Signet Artists
props.seo_title: Quadrasonic, a Vail Valley rock band, joins Signet Artists
props.dek: Quadrasonic, a four-piece alternative rock band from the Vail Valley, is now one of our Featured Artists.
props.meta_description: Vail Valley rock band Quadrasonic joins Signet Artists. They play Pat Benatar, No Doubt, Nirvana and Paramore at Colorado weddings and parties.
props.llms_description: This post announces that Quadrasonic, a four-piece alternative rock cover band from the Vail Valley in Colorado, is now a Featured Artist with Signet Artists. It covers the stages they play, the rock songs on their song list from the 1970s to today, and how to book them for weddings, birthday parties, company parties and retreats in Vail and across Colorado.

hero.alt: Quadrasonic’s singer in a red and black patterned catsuit singing into a microphone, with the guitarist in red plaid pants beside her and the band’s name lit up behind them.

video.title: Quadrasonic playing Hit Me With Your Best Shot

props.html:
We’re excited to share that Quadrasonic is now one of our Featured Artists! They’re a four-piece alternative rock band from the Vail Valley, with lead vocals, electric guitar, bass and drums, and they play the rock songs your guests grew up singing along to.

Their singer has been on stage her whole life. She can go from a grunge growl to soaring high notes, and she brings a little theater to every show.

props.caption: Quadrasonic playing Pat Benatar’s Hit Me With Your Best Shot.

props.html: The band plays weddings, festivals, summer concert series and clubs all over Colorado, including the GoPro Mountain Games in Vail and Copper Mountain’s summer concert series. In 2025 the Vail Daily introduced them to Eagle County as a new alternative rock band.

Their song list runs from the ’70s to today, with a lot of ’90s alternative radio in the middle. You’ll hear Pat Benatar, Blondie and Joan Jett alongside Nirvana, No Doubt, The Cranberries and Garbage, and newer songs from Paramore and Chappell Roan. They play a few pop hits too, like Toxic and Levitating, with the guitars turned up.

Quadrasonic plays as a four-piece band, and they’re a great choice when you want people dancing at a wedding reception, a big birthday or a company party. If you’re getting married in Vail or Beaver Creek, or bringing your team to Vail for a retreat, a band that lives in the valley is an easy fit.

Want to hear more? Check out Quadrasonic’s video clips and song list.

props.headline: Want to book Quadrasonic for your event?
props.html: Just send us your date and venue, and we’ll let you know if they’re available.
